caption: This drawing depicts a person shown in profile, facing to the right, standing on a brown, oval-shaped platform. The figure has light skin and short, dark brown hair covered partly by a light gray or off-white headdress with a ribbed or pleated texture. The person is bare-chested, with distinct pink nipples and some reddish shading around the shoulder and elbow area. Both arms are bent at the elbows and crossed in front of the body, with yellow gloves covering the hands. The figure wears a long, high-waisted skirt in shades of light blue and turquoise, decorated with vertical blue lines and ornate, swirling green and blue patterns that run down the length of the fabric; the bottom edge of the skirt is adorned with blue, green, and gold scalloped trim. The background is plain and light-colored, with no additional objects or scenery. The drawing is signed in the lower right corner with the name "Matel G. Chaplin - Thos."
title: Santa (One of Eight Virgins) Side View
